title: BusductTherMo — Alarm Configuration Domain (cfg/alarms)
description: Operational tuning domain: threshold profiles, persistence, and notification routing. Remotely tunable (unlike cfg/modbus and cfg/joints, no maintenance-mode gate required). Field names align with the existing Node-RED Config Manager (deltaT / ror / persistence) so migration is a direct mapping. Applied atomically after schema + x-edge-validation checks; every accepted change is written to the audit trail and the applied version reported on the ack channel.

delta_t_thresholds.description: ΔT thresholds in °C (joint temp minus ambient, EMA-smoothed). Must satisfy watch < warning < critical (rule A1).

ror_thresholds.description: Rate-of-Rise thresholds in °C/hr over timeWindowMin. Must satisfy watch < warning < critical (rule A1).

timeWindowMin.description: EMA time window (tau) in minutes; drives RoR smoothing in ProcessLogic

persistence.description: Minutes a condition must persist before the alarm is raised. Higher severity reacts faster: watchMin >= warningMin >= criticalMin (rule A2).

clear_hysteresis_pct.description: Value must fall this % below the raise threshold before CLEAR is evaluated, to prevent raise/clear chatter at the boundary.

clear_persistence_min.description: Minutes the value must stay below (threshold - hysteresis) before the alarm clears.

config_domain_versions.description: Monotonic version. Edge rejects a push whose version is <= currently applied (rule A6).

profiles.description: Named threshold profiles. 'default' is mandatory and applies to every joint whose threshold_profile is 'default' or unset. Additional profiles are referenced by joints[].threshold_profile in cfg/joints.

sensor_fault.description: System-alarm behaviour for sensor/communication faults (maps to Alarm Manager SYSTEM category).

comm_timeout_s.description: No valid data from the Nano/bus for this long -> SYSTEM COMM_FAILURE alarm.

sensor_error_above_c.description: Reading above this value is treated as Sensor_Error and freezes KPI updates for that joint (matches ProcessLogic freeze).

notifications.description: Edge-local notification routing (email/SMS). Cloud-side routing is configured cloud-side; these settings keep the edge autonomous when offline.

min_level.description: Lowest severity that triggers an email.

rate_limit_per_hour.description: Max emails per hour panel-wide; excess events are summarised in the next email.

cloud_alarm_publish.description: Controls the alarm event stream to cloud (dt/.../alarm). Independent of local email/SMS.

min_level.description: Cloud normally receives everything; raise this only to reduce message volume.

x-edge-validation.description: Cross-field rules the edge MUST enforce beyond JSON Schema. Any failure -> reject entire push atomically, report reason on cmd/../config/ack.
rules: A1  Ordering: for every profile, deltaT.watch < deltaT.warning < deltaT.critical AND ror.watch < ror.warning < ror.critical (strict).
A2  Persistence ordering: persistence.watchMin >= persistence.warningMin >= persistence.criticalMin.
A3  Profile references resolve: every joints[].threshold_profile in the currently applied cfg/joints must exist in profiles{}. A push that deletes a profile still referenced by a joint is rejected.
A4  'default' profile cannot be deleted or renamed.
A5  Ambient dependency: deltaT alarming requires ambient_sensor configured in cfg/modbus; if absent, reject unless every profile's deltaT section is explicitly disabled by agreed convention.
A6  Version monotonicity: incoming config_domain_versions.alarms must be > currently applied version.
A7  Notification sanity: if email.enabled or sms.enabled, recipients must be non-empty.
A8  Applied atomically: on any accepted change write before/after to the audit trail, publish applied version on ack/reported channel, retain last-known-good snapshot for boot fallback.
A9  Hysteresis sanity: clear_hysteresis_pct of the watch threshold must not push the clear level below 0 for deltaT.

A10 Live re-evaluation: after apply, active alarms are re-evaluated against new thresholds on the next sample; alarms whose condition no longer holds follow the normal clear path (with clear persistence), never an instant mass-clear.

hot_tapoff.description: Known-hot tap-off boxes; relaxed deltaT, same RoR vigilance
